# Expected skips on macos-latest (darwin/arm64). Derived from the t.Skip sites
# in the source, not measured on a runner: the first red run corrects it.

# The success path is verified out-of-process (TestHelpersIsolated is Linux
# only); this test is the ErrUnsupported pin for platforms without a
# core-dump rlimit, so it skips wherever there is one.
github.com/deadpoets/secmem TestDisableCoreDumps_Unsupported

# The forced-exit status only has to match the OS default on Windows.
github.com/deadpoets/secmem TestForcedExitStatus_MatchesUninterceptedSignal

# Seed #1 is the empty plaintext: a zero-length buffer is refused by the core
# by design, so this seed skips on every platform.
github.com/deadpoets/secmem/secmem-crypto FuzzOpenInto_RoundTrip/seed#1
